atomic_questions.shared_background: By a final decree dated 15th September 2002 entered in District Court of Kaduwela in Partition Case No.3562/P land and premises bearing Assessment No.02, Sunil Mawatha, Malabe depicted as Lot 1 in Partition Plan No.528 dated 03 April 2000 made by K.P. Silva Licensed Surveyor in extent 18 Perches was allotted to Manel Silva. She was married to Kamal Silva and had 2 children namely Dilani and Diyath. By Deed of Gift No.752 dated 10 March 2007 attested by Sunil Perera Notary Public, the said Lot 1 was gifted to her daughter Dilaní Silva as an absolute and irrevocable gift subject to life interest of the said Donor Manel Silva, Manel. died on 31 May 2008. Dilani had a son named Sarath by her first husband Kävindu. Kavindu died on 05th June 2011, Dilani died intestate on 02nd October 2010 leaving her second husband Lakmal and two children namely Kanthi and Piyal. And her estate was duly administered in District Court of Kaduwela in Testamentary Case No. 452/2010/T. The said proceedings were terminated on 12th February 2011 and the Administrator's Conveyance No.758 dated 19th February 2011 attested by D. Perera Notary Public was executed by Lakmal who was the Administrator of the estate of his late wife Dilani. Sarath married Rani and died intestate on 03rd February 2013 without leaving children. Piyal met with an accident and died on 07th August 2018 unmarried and issueless.
